title: connect
description: Start talking to a switcher, under a slug of your choosing; it keeps reconnecting by itself until disconnect.

id.description: A slug for the switcher, such as atem-main.

address.description: The switcher's IP address or host name, with :port only when it is not 9910.

name.description: A name for people, such as Main switcher. The id when left out.

mode.description: own: driven only from the window and agents. follow: a GodwinMix take also cuts it. lead: a cut on its panel moves GodwinMix.

map.description: GodwinMix source id to ATEM input number.
